title: File:The Earth seen from Apollo 17.jpg
author: NASA/Apollo 17 crew; taken by either Harrison Schmitt or Ron Evans
description: "The Blue Marble" is a famous photograph of the Earth taken on December 7, 1972, by the crew of the Apollo 17 spacecraft en route to the Moon at a distance of about 29,400 kilometres (18,300 mi). It shows Africa, Antarctica, and the Arabian Peninsula.
